verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native scheduling or recurring-job feature in Codex. It does document non-interactive `codex exec` for repeatable workflows, scripts, CI and pipelines, so users can get recurring runs by wiring Codex into an external scheduler (cron or CI). Missing for 10: a built-in scheduler or recurring-task configuration, cloud-side scheduled runs, and documentation or hands-on evidence of scheduled Codex workflows.
